attributes.name: Druva - Protected Workload Removed
attributes.description: Detects administrative activity indicating that a protected workload or resource was removed from Druva protection.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects administrative activity indicating that a protected workload or resource was removed from Druva protection.

attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and (
  message:*workload*
  or message:*resource*
  or druva.resource.name:*
)
and (
  message:*removed*
  or message:*unprotected*
  or message:*deleted from*
)
